author: Bill Ferguson
name: select_unaltered
description: Selects images in the current collection that have never been edited, opened in darkroom, or had a style applied.
description-extensive: This quickly picks out all the photos in your current view that you haven't touched yet, meaning they were just imported and have had no edits or styles applied. It's a fast way to find the images that still need your attention. No extra software is required.
